title.rendered: Labour Colony in North Delhi — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Infrastructure work across Pitampura, Rohini, and Civil Lines keeps demand high for quality worker accommodation. As metro extensions, commercial complexes, and government projects move through North Delhi, contractors need a compliant labour colony in North Delhi that uses space efficiently and goes up fast. SAMAN Portable supplies prefabricated worker housing built for these urban, high-density sites, dispatched factory-direct from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 unit.

SAMAN manufactures and dispatches labour colony units directly from our Greater Noida facility (Jalpura, PIN 201308) — factory-to-site delivery across Delhi NCR without middlemen. North Delhi sites — across the Narela, Bawana and Wazirpur industrial belts — are a direct NCR dispatch from the same plant.

As a direct manufacturer — serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019 (POS = Portable Office Solutions) — we build to IS 2062 structural steel under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001 systems, with 500+ projects delivered across India and NSIC and DPIIT recognition. Our Greater Noida unit is at Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308. Our portable labour hutments carry a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Large sites are expected to provide suitable worker accommodation under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act and related state welfare rules, which cover sanitation, minimum space per worker, ventilation and fire safety — a planned colony supports these requirements.

The Growing Need for Labour Colonies in North Delhi

North Delhi's construction activity continues to drive demand for worker housing. Across Pitampura, Rohini, and Civil Lines, contractors need a labour colony that balances comfortable accommodation with space efficiency and rapid deployment.

Current Challenges in Worker Housing

  • Limited space in high-density zones like Rohini Sector 24
  • Compliance with local municipal and safety standards
  • Monsoon-resistant structures needed for year-round projects
  • Worker retention issues caused by substandard accommodation
  • Rising land costs that make traditional labour colonies expensive

Why Modular Labour Camps Are the Solution

Modular labour camps balance quality, speed, and cost for North Delhi projects. These prefabricated, panel-built structures install quickly, providing worker housing while meeting practical safety and comfort standards.

SAMAN Portable's prefab worker housing is engineered for North Delhi's urban density, with vertical G+1 and G+2 layouts that make the most of limited plot areas while keeping accommodation comfortable for workers.

As a direct manufacturer, SAMAN supplies its full prefabricated labour colony range across North Delhi, built on an IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels and backed by 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

Durability Meets Design: PUF, MS Frame, and RCC Explained

The Science Behind Our Materials

SAMAN's labour colonies use materials chosen for North Delhi's climate, combining durability with comfort through careful material selection.

PUF Panels: The Insulation Layer

Polyurethane foam (PUF) panels give strong thermal insulation, helping keep interiors comfortable through the year. Typical ~50–60mm panels offer:

  • Better temperature control during summer heat and winter cold
  • Noticeable sound dampening between rooms
  • Moisture resistance that helps prevent mould and mildew

IS 2062 MS Frame: Strength and Longevity

The structural frame and base are built from IS 2062 mild steel, giving the labour colony durability for North Delhi conditions:

  • Corrosion-protected steel suited to monsoon exposure
  • Fire-resistant panel construction
  • Good impact resistance against debris
  • Low maintenance over the service life
  • Lightweight assembly that is still structurally sound

RCC Foundations: The Stability Factor

Reinforced cement concrete foundations keep the prefab worker shelters stable and level:

  • Reduce settling and shifting in Delhi's clay-heavy soils
  • Lift the floor above ground for monsoon protection
  • Support safe multi-storey G+1 and G+2 configurations

Pitampura to Civil Lines: Area-Wise Worker Housing

Pitampura: Compact Solutions for Commercial Projects

Pitampura's dense commercial zones need space-efficient worker housing. For this area we can supply:

  • Vertical G+1 designs that house more workers on a smaller plot
  • Noise-dampening PUF panels for residential proximity
  • Fast installation to meet commercial project timelines
  • Custom layouts for the irregular plot shapes common in Pitampura
Send Enquiry

Rohini: Scalable Solutions for Infrastructure Projects

Rohini's infrastructure work calls for larger worker accommodation with flexible scaling:

  • G+2 designs that house more workers per plot
  • Modular expansion for phased project growth
  • Added security features for high-value infrastructure sites
  • Reinforced foundations for Rohini's variable soil conditions
Call +91 62009 09435

Civil Lines: Low-Profile Worker Housing

Civil Lines often needs lower-profile worker housing that sits discreetly near older buildings and government zones:

  • Low-profile designs with neutral exterior finishes
  • ACP cladding options for visual integration
  • Noise-minimising construction
  • Compact sanitation suited to limited-infrastructure areas

G+1 & G+2 Designs for High-Density Sites

Maximising Worker Capacity in Limited Space

North Delhi's high land costs make vertical labour colonies an economical choice. SAMAN's multi-storey designs offer:

  • Double or triple the capacity on the same footprint
  • Lower per-worker land cost
  • Improved security with consolidated entry points
  • Better ventilation through elevated positioning
  • Better drainage and flood protection

Safety Features in Multi-Storey Designs

Our G+1 and G+2 labour colonies include practical safety features:

  • MS railings on stairs and balconies
  • Non-slip staircase treads with proper lighting
  • Fire-resistant cladding and emergency exits
  • Reinforced load-bearing IS 2062 steel structure
  • Lightning protection provisions

Time-Saving Construction & Installation Process

Step 1: Site Preparation

Our team handles site levelling, foundation marking, and ground preparation.

Step 2: Modular Assembly

Pre-fabricated units arrive and are positioned with crane-assisted placement.

Step 3: Finishing & Handover

Electrical, plumbing, and finishing work is completed, followed by inspection and handover.

  • Less weather exposure during construction

FAQs: Labour Colony in North Delhi


How quickly can SAMAN install a labour colony in North Delhi?

Because units are prefabricated in our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory and shipped ready to assemble, on-site work in North Delhi is fast — typically a few days for ground-floor layouts and a little longer for G+1 or G+2 designs. The exact timeline depends on capacity, site access, and foundation work, which we confirm after a site assessment.


What does a labour colony in North Delhi cost?

Pricing is quote-based, since it depends on worker capacity, the number of floors (ground, G+1 or G+2), amenities such as toilets and a kitchen block, and site conditions. Share your worker count and timeline and we will prepare a customised quote. Contact us on +91 62009 09435 or use the enquiry form.


Are SAMAN's labour colonies suited to North Delhi's climate?

Yes. The insulated PUF panels help control interior temperature through summer heat and winter cold, while the IS 2062 MS steel frame with weather-resistant coating handles monsoon exposure. Raised RCC or steel-frame foundations help keep the floor clear of water during heavy rain.


Can the labour colony be relocated after the project ends?

Yes. The modular, panel-built construction is designed to be dismantled and reassembled at a new site, which suits contractors moving between sequential projects across North Delhi. We can advise on dismantling and relocation when you plan the project.


What warranty and certification back the labour colony?

SAMAN is an ISO 9001:2015 manufacturer and the structure is built on an IS 2062 MS frame. The warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing, with a 20–25 years engineered service life (the service life is an engineering estimate, not a warranty period). Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel labour colony units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308).
